description: Java class MapStack extending MapContext, providing stack-based map management with methods for creating, copying, and managing context stacks, including special handling for 'context' key and sharing maps between parent and child stacks.

classes.name: MapStack
classes.description: A stack-based map class for managing nested contexts, with methods for creating and sharing map contexts.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new MapStack instance, optionally initialized with a base map or copying from another MapStack.

methods.name: standAloneStack
methods.description: Returns a new MapStack sharing the same maps as the current one, for parent-child context sharing.

methods.name: standAloneChildStack
methods.description: Returns a new MapStack with the same maps as the current one, but with a new map pushed on top, for nested context.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value by key; returns the MapStack itself if key is 'context'.

methods.name: get (Locale version)
methods.description: Retrieves a localized value by name and locale; returns the MapStack itself if name is 'context'.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Puts a key-value pair into the map; logs a warning if key is 'context' and value is not the current MapStack.
